She says the world is different now.
Remember when things were simple?
_
Remember when we used to wait eagerly for summer?
_ 
Things are all going to shit now. Everything's different.
It's like someone warped reality.
Or was it always like this?
_
Were we lied to?
Or is this what it means to be an adult?

Merry: What are we off to again?
Gizzard: Asking me? … Fuck if I know.
_
Merry: Sarge, What's the plan? Saving a bunch of kids?
Gizzard: Or animals, innit?
_
Stiff: …
_
Gizzard: Maybe it was about killing some sort of undead?
Merry: Can't kill 'em.
_
Gizzard: Or bandits?
Merry: I think I recall bandits, yeah. From the brief.
Gizzard: You've had a brief?? Come on…
_
Stiff: You did too, Gizz. I think.
Gizzard: Weren't you the one giving it?
Stiff: I imagine I should've been.
_
Stiff: Anyway, let's get this going. They should be close now.
_
Merry: So it WAS bandits! I knew it.
Stiff: See, you're not such a no-good.

ACTE II — LA FAILLE _ Le calme retombe sur le Bastion repris… puis la terre gémit, plus loin, au-delà des crêtes. Une faille s’ouvre dans le territoire voisin, et la même corruption s’en échappe. _ Deux volontaires du village rejoignent l’escouade : Kael, garde aguerri, et Wren, lame silencieuse. Sorne resserre sa robe. _ Sorne : J’ai déjà senti ça. Au Hameau. Mais ici, ça vient d’une source — un cœur qui bat sous la Faille. Si on ne l’éteint pas, tout le pays se déformera.

Le Verrou est tombé. Au-delà s'ouvre le dernier territoire — là où la Faille bat le plus fort.
_
Il faut atteindre le Cœur et l'étouffer.

Au cœur de la Faille, le mage noir s’effondre dans un dernier éclat. _ La corruption reflue, lentement, comme une marée qui se retire. _ Sorne : C’est éteint. Pour l’instant. _ Kael : Et le pays respire. On rentre — il reste des feux à allumer au camp. _ FIN DE L’ACTE II.
